-- CETAS --
CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE ext_cetas_tbl
with(
    LOCATION = 'ext_cetas',
    DATA_SOURCE = ext_11,
    FILE_FORMAT = parquet_format
)
AS
SELECT *
FROM 
OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'Revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'ext_11',
    FORMAT = 'CSV',
    PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
)as query1 

SELECT * from ext_cetas_tbl
